result.topic_en: Calculations on propagating compression waves (shocks) in Riemann's gas-dynamics setting: Riemann invariants p, q, density ratio across the jump, jump conditions in Δp, Δq, similarity ansatz Δp ∝ t^{1/2} with algebra for α, β, and integration of a related equation for w(p,q).
result.transcription:
Verdichtungsstoß[?] {Stoßwelle[?]}
$\frac{\partial p}{\partial t} = -(u+a)\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}$ $\frac{\partial q}{\partial t} = -(u-a)\frac{\partial q}{\partial x}$
$\frac{\partial x}{\partial t} = u_1 + a\sqrt{\frac{\varrho_2}{\varrho_1}} = u_2 + a\sqrt{\frac{\varrho_1}{\varrho_2}}$ $2(\Delta p+\Delta q) - e^{\Delta p-\Delta q} + e^{\Delta q-\Delta p} = 0$ [-$4\Delta p = \sqrt{\frac{\varrho_1}{\varrho_2}} + \sqrt{\frac{\varrho_2}{\varrho_1}} - \sqrt{\frac{\varrho_2}{\varrho_1}}$-]
$\frac{\partial p_1}{\partial t} = \frac{\partial p}{\partial t} + \frac{\partial p}{\partial x}\frac{\partial x}{\partial t} = \left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}\right)_1 a\left(\sqrt{\frac{\varrho_2}{\varrho_1}} - 1\right)$
$\frac{\partial p_2}{\partial t} = \left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}\right)_2 a\left(\sqrt{\frac{\varrho_1}{\varrho_2}} - 1\right)$
$\frac{\partial q_2}{\partial t} = \left(\frac{\partial q}{\partial x}\right)_2 a\left(\sqrt{\frac{\varrho_1}{\varrho_2}} + 1\right)$
$0 = \frac{\partial \Delta p}{\partial t}\left(2 - e^{\Delta p-\Delta q} - e^{\Delta q-\Delta p}\right) + \frac{\partial \Delta q}{\partial t}\left(2 + e^{\Delta p-\Delta q} + e^{\Delta q-\Delta p}\right)$, $\frac{\partial \Delta p}{\partial t}(\sqrt{\varrho_1}-\sqrt{\varrho_2})^2 = \frac{\partial \Delta q}{\partial t}(\sqrt{\varrho_1}+\sqrt{\varrho_2})^2$
$\frac{\partial \Delta p}{\partial t} = \left(\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}\right)_1\sqrt{\frac{\varrho_2}{\varrho_1}} - \left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}\right)_2\right) a\sqrt{\frac{\varrho_1}{\varrho_2}} - 1$
$\frac{\partial \Delta p}{\partial t} = \left(\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}\right)_1\sqrt{\frac{1}{\varrho_1}} - \left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}\right)_2\sqrt{\frac{1}{\varrho_2}}\right) a(\sqrt{\varrho_1}-\sqrt{\varrho_2})$
$\frac{\partial \Delta q}{\partial t} = \left(\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}\right)_1\sqrt{\frac{1}{\varrho_1}} - \left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}\right)_2\sqrt{\frac{1}{\varrho_2}}\right) \frac{a(\sqrt{\varrho_1}-\sqrt{\varrho_2})^3}{(\sqrt{\varrho_1}+\sqrt{\varrho_2})^2}$
$\frac{\partial q_1}{\partial t} = \frac{\partial q_2}{\partial t} + \frac{\partial \Delta q}{\partial t}$ $\frac{(\sqrt{\varrho_1}+\sqrt{\varrho_2})^2}{a}\frac{\partial q_1}{\partial t} = \left(\frac{\partial q}{\partial x}\right)_2\frac{1}{\sqrt{\varrho_2}}(\sqrt{\varrho_1}+\sqrt{\varrho_2})^3 + \left(\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}\right)_1\sqrt{\frac{1}{\varrho_1}} - \left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}\right)_2\sqrt{\frac{1}{\varrho_2}}\right)(\sqrt{\varrho_1}-\sqrt{\varrho_2})^3$

$\sqrt{\frac{\varrho_1}{\varrho_2}} = e^{\Delta q-\Delta p} = \alpha = e^{\frac{1}{2}\Delta\log\varrho}$ $\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}\right)_2 (t-p_2^2) = 1$
$4\Delta p = -2\log\alpha + \alpha + \frac{1}{\alpha} = -\int_1^{\alpha} d\alpha\left(1+\frac{1}{\alpha}\right)^2$ $4\Delta q = -\int_1^{\alpha} d\alpha\left(1-\frac{1}{\alpha}\right)^2$
$2(p-q) = \log\varrho$ $0 = 4\Delta p + 4(\Delta q-\Delta p) + \frac{2(\Delta q-\Delta p)^3}{3!} + \frac{(\Delta q-\Delta p)^5}{5!} = 0$
$\Delta p - \Delta q = (\alpha+\beta)t^{\frac{1}{2}}$

$p_1 = \alpha t^{\frac{1}{2}}$
$p_2 = \beta t^{\frac{1}{2}}$
$\Delta p = (\alpha+\beta)t^{\frac{1}{2}}$
$\sqrt{\frac{\varrho_1}{\varrho_2}} = 1 + (\alpha+\beta)t^{\frac{1}{2}}$
$t - p_2^2 = (1-\beta^2)t$
$\sqrt{\frac{\varrho_1}{\varrho_2}} - 1 = (\alpha+\beta)t^{\frac{1}{2}}$
$\frac{1}{2}\frac{(\alpha+\beta)}{1-\beta^2}t^{-\frac{1}{2}} = -\frac{1}{2}\beta t^{-\frac{1}{2}}$
$\alpha+\beta = -\beta(1-\beta^2)$
$\alpha = -2\beta + \beta^3 = \beta(\beta^2-2)$ $\beta^2-\beta-1 = 0$
$\alpha>1$ $\beta>1$ $\beta^2>2$ $\beta^2-\beta+\frac{1}{4} = \frac{5}{4}$
$\beta - \frac{1}{2} = \pm\frac{\sqrt{5}}{2}$
$\beta = \frac{1}{2} + \frac{\sqrt{5}}{2}$

$\alpha = -2\beta+\beta^3$
$\beta = \alpha + 2\alpha^3$[?]
[-$\alpha+2\beta = \beta^3$-]
[-$\beta+2\alpha = \alpha^3$-]
$3(\alpha+\beta) = \alpha^3+\beta^3$
$\alpha-\beta = \alpha^3-\beta^3$
$\alpha^2-\alpha\beta+\beta^2 = 3$
$\alpha^2+\alpha\beta+\beta^2 = 1$
$\alpha^2\beta^2 = 2$
$\alpha\beta = -1$
$(\alpha+\beta)^2 = 0$ $(\alpha-\beta)^2 = 4$

$\beta(\beta^2-2) + 1 = 0$ $\beta+1$
$\beta+1)\beta^3-2\beta-1 = \beta^2-\beta-1$
$\beta^3+\beta^2$ $\beta^3-\beta^2-\beta$
$-\beta^2$ $\beta^2-\beta-1$
$\alpha = \beta$ $\beta^2 = \alpha^2 = 3$

$\Delta p = \alpha t^{\frac{1}{2}}$[?]

$\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial p^2} = -2ap^2$
[-$2at$-] $2at + \frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial p^2}$
$\frac{\partial w}{\partial p} = -\frac{2}{3}ap^3 = x - 2at(p+\frac{1}{2})$
$x - (p+\frac{1}{2})2at = -\frac{2}{3}ap^3$
[-...-]
$x = (p-\frac{1}{2})2at$
$x = (p-\frac{1}{2})2at$
$\frac{\partial x}{\partial t} = (p-\frac{1}{2})2a$

$\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial p\partial q} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial q} = -\frac{2}{3}ap^3$
$\frac{\partial\left(e^p\frac{\partial w}{\partial q}\right)}{\partial p} = -\frac{2}{3}ap^3e^p$ $+\int e^p 4a\,dp$
$e^p\frac{\partial w}{\partial q} = -\int e^p\frac{2}{3}ap^3dp = -e^p\frac{2}{3}ap^3 + e^p 2ap^2 - e^p 4ap + (e^p-1)4a$
$\frac{\partial w}{\partial q} = -\frac{2}{3}ap^3 + 2ap^2 - 4ap + 4a(1-e^{-p}) = x - (p+\frac{1}{2})2at = 4a\left(-e^{-p}+1-p+\frac{p^2}{2}-\frac{p^3}{6}\right) = 4a\left(-\frac{p^4}{4!}+\frac{p^5}{5!}-\dots\right)$
$\frac{\partial w}{\partial p} = -\frac{2}{3}ap^3 - (x-(p+\frac{1}{2})2at)$
$2at = 4a\left(-e^{-p}+1-p+\frac{p^2}{2}\right) = 4a\left(\frac{p^3}{3!}-\frac{p^4}{4!}\right)$

$\frac{\partial t}{\partial q} = .\,t^{-\frac{1}{2}}$[?]
